person.profile: P B Rangarao holds a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Regional Engineering College, Warangal, and a Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management from XIME, Bengaluru. He has also completed a Leadership Development Program from the Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Ahmedabad. Shri P B Rangarao joined HAL on July 17, 1995, as part of the 3rd batch of Design Trainees and brings with him more than three decades of extensive experience across multiple domains within the organization. Over the course of his 31 years career at HAL, he has served in several key roles across departments including Plant Maintenance, ALH Manufacturing Shops, Ch/Ck Transmission and Blade Shop, Head of Ch/CK project, Outsourcing, and Planning.
